name: ActionDock Project Knowledge
description: Built-in OCKB project knowledge plugin with async Chief/Planner/Worker agent orchestration, phased reconciliation, and ACTIONDOCK.md entry.

actions.title: Initialize OCKB Knowledge Base
actions.description: Start an async OCKB initialization run. The plugin creates Chief, Planner, and Worker agents through the selected runner, then validates the result.

repoPath.title: Repository Path
repoPath.description: Absolute or workspace-resolved repository root path where ACTIONDOCK.md and .knowledge_base will be maintained.

evidenceFiles.title: Evidence Files
evidenceFiles.description: Additional repository-relative files whose content should be treated as evidence during initialization.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Preferred knowledge-base audience hint such as 'balanced' or 'new-developer'.

detailLevel.title: Detail Level
detailLevel.description: Desired documentation depth such as 'standard' or 'detailed'.

aiProfile.title: AI Profile
aiProfile.description: Internal agent profile to use when runner.type is 'internal'.

runner.title: Runner
runner.description: Agent execution channel. The caller chooses internal or external-cli and the plugin creates Chief/Planner/Worker agents through this runner.

aiProfile.description: Optional profile override for internal runner.

command.description: Command prefix for external-cli runner, for example ['claude', '-p'].

envKeys.description: Environment variable names allowed to pass through to the external CLI process.

runId.description: Async knowledge run identifier, for example 'init-a1b2c3d4'.

actions.title: Refresh OCKB Knowledge Base
actions.description: Start a manually triggered async refresh run.

repoPath.title: Repository Path
repoPath.description: Repository root path of an already initialized OCKB knowledge base.

changedFiles.title: Changed Files
changedFiles.description: Repository-relative changed files that should drive phase routing. If omitted, the plugin tries to derive changes from Git diff.

runner.title: Runner
runner.description: Agent execution channel used for Chief/Planner/Worker orchestration.

aiProfile.description: Optional profile override for internal runner.

envKeys.description: Environment variable names allowed to pass through to the external CLI process.

actions.title: Ingest Manual Knowledge Sources
actions.description: Start a manually triggered async ingest run for files or directories.

repoPath.title: Repository Path
repoPath.description: Repository root path of an already initialized OCKB knowledge base.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Files or directories to ingest, typically inbox notes, runbooks, or manually supplied design material.

runner.title: Runner
runner.description: Agent execution channel used for Chief/Planner/Worker orchestration.

aiProfile.description: Optional profile override for internal runner.

envKeys.description: Environment variable names allowed to pass through to the external CLI process.

actions.title: Validate OCKB Knowledge Base
actions.description: Validate ACTIONDOCK.md and the OCKB pure Markdown document tree.

repoPath.title: Repository Path
repoPath.description: Repository root path whose ACTIONDOCK.md and .knowledge_base tree should be validated.

ok.description: Whether the current formal knowledge base passes the plugin quality gate.

issues.description: Validation issues found in ACTIONDOCK.md or .knowledge_base.

actions.title: Get Knowledge Run
actions.description: Read an async OCKB run snapshot.

repoPath.title: Repository Path
repoPath.description: Repository root path containing the run snapshot.

runId.title: Run ID
runId.description: Async run identifier returned by init, refresh, or ingest.

mode.description: Knowledge action mode: init, refresh, or ingest.

status.description: Run state: RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, or CANCELLED.

result.description: Final run payload. On success it contains result.status, phases, changedFiles, warnings, and qualityGate.

errorMessage.description: Failure or cancellation reason when status is FAILED or CANCELLED.

actions.title: Cancel Knowledge Run
actions.description: Mark an async OCKB run as cancelled.

repoPath.title: Repository Path
repoPath.description: Repository root path containing the run snapshot.

runId.title: Run ID
runId.description: Async run identifier to mark as cancelled.
